using System;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

public class EntityFrameworkServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddDbContextPool_adds_services_correctly_when_types_are_equal()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var optionsAction = (IServiceProvider sp, DbContextOptionsBuilder b) => { };

        // Act
        services.AddDbContextPool<TestContext, TestContext>(optionsAction);

        // Assert
        using var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var pool = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IDbContextPool<TestContext>>();
        Assert.NotNull(pool);
        Assert.IsType<DbContextPool<TestContext>>(pool);

        var lease = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IScopedDbContextLease<TestContext>>();
        Assert.NotNull(lease);
        Assert.NotNull(lease.Context);

        var context = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<TestContext>();
        Assert.NotNull(context);
        Assert.Same(lease.Context, context);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddDbContextPool_adds_implementation_service_when_types_differ()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var optionsAction = (IServiceProvider sp, DbContextOptionsBuilder b) => { };

        // Act
        services.AddDbContextPool<ITestContext, TestContext>(optionsAction);

        // Assert
        using var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var serviceContext = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<ITestContext>();
        Assert.NotNull(serviceContext);

        var implContext = serviceProvider.GetService<TestContext>();
        Assert.NotNull(implContext);
        Assert.IsAssignableFrom<TestContext>(serviceContext);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddDbContextPool_does_not_add_implementation_service_when_types_are_equal()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var optionsAction = (IServiceProvider sp, DbContextOptionsBuilder b) => { };

        // Act
        services.AddDbContextPool<TestContext, TestContext>(optionsAction);

        // Assert
        using var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => serviceProvider.GetService<TestContext>());
        Assert.Equal("Unable to resolve service for type 'TestContext' while attempting to activate...", ex.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddDbContextPool_uses_default_pool_size()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var optionsAction = (IServiceProvider sp, DbContextOptionsBuilder b) =>
        {
            var extension = b.Options.FindExtension<CoreOptionsExtension>()!;
            Assert.Equal(1024, extension.MaxPoolSize);
        };

        // Act
        services.AddDbContextPool<TestContext, TestContext>(optionsAction);

        // Assert - just verify it builds/runs
        using var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        Assert.NotNull(serviceProvider.GetService<TestContext>());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddDbContextPool_throws_for_invalid_pool_size()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var optionsAction = (IServiceProvider sp, DbContextOptionsBuilder b) => { };

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => services.AddDbContextPool<TestContext, TestContext>(optionsAction, 0));
        Assert.Equal("poolSize", ex.ParamName);
    }
}

public class TestContext : DbContext
{
}

public interface ITestContext : DbContext
{
}
